comments.text: Level data $7EC0-$7EC1: Loaded level identifier checked at $16A6 and its following palette byte.

Level data $8192-$8391: Level-loaded continuation of the actor-template directory and its adjacent level-specific actor parameters. Actor constructors use the pointer table at $817C, with the high-index half at $827C.

Level data $8392-$83DF: Level-loaded continuation of the actor-template directory and its adjacent level-specific actor parameters. Actor constructors use the pointer table at $817C, with the high-index half at $827C.
Level data $8F00-$8FBF: Level-specific continuation of the actor shape stream read at $8EC0 plus a byte index. $FF introduces a loop index, or $FF/$FF ends the actor.

Level data $8FC0-$90DF: Level exit records: edge selector, source world block, destination scroll positions, right scroll limits and destination X. The exit handler at $3096 searches the count in $806C.
Level data $90E0-$9141: Paired path pointer directories used by $418E to select magnitude and direction streams.

Level data $9142-$9341: Actor initialisation records addressed through the template directory. The two constructor readers copy 26 bytes into display, collision, health, animation and motion arrays; offset 6 is score class in $3C32 and X expansion in $4F04.
